E-1927-002 — 1927-06-03 — BOILER NO. 1 — ROUTINE MAINTENANCE
Location: Power House, Boiler Room
Maintenance performed by: B. Kowalski, Stationary Engineer

Cleaned fire tubes and removed scale from the water side. Checked safety valve
setting: 125 psi. Replaced one gauge glass. Fired up and tested; appears to hold
pressure satisfactorily. Boiler room floor swept and tools returned to rack.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
E-1927-003 — 1927-06-28 — LIGHTING CIRCUIT — REPAIR
Location: Gallery B, East Wing
Reported by: Night Watchman R. O’Brien

Two ceiling fixtures in Gallery B flickering during evening hours. Found loose
connection at the junction box above the ceiling. Tightened and taped. Replaced
one lamp. Circuit tested with a lamp load; all outlets now steady. No further
trouble reported.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
E-1927-004 — 1927-07-12 — PUMP NO. 2 — ROUTINE MAINTENANCE
Location: Power House, Pump Room
Maintenance performed by: B. Kowalski, Stationary Engineer

Packed the stuffing box on Pump No. 2. Adjusted belt tension. Oiled all grease
cups. Pump ran for one hour under load; discharge pressure steady at 60 psi.
Noted that the suction strainer is corroding; recommend replacement within the
year.

Marginal note (pencil, E. Vance, 1999): “Strainer replaced 1928-01-15, see
E-1928-002.”

------------------------------------------------------------------------
E-1927-005 — 1927-08-05 — OLD MAIN ELEVATOR — ROUTINE MAINTENANCE
Location: Main Building, Central Shaft
Maintenance performed by: Meridian Elevator & Hoist Co. (call-out)

The Historic Mechanical Systems Log entry E-1927-001 records that Old Main Elevator installation_date was 1927-05-15. Record status: current.

Inspected elevator after three months of service. Adjusted door interlocks.
Lubricated guide shoes and hoist cables. Checked travel limits; both limits
functioning. Car floor and cab interior cleaned. No abnormal wear noted.
Next inspection recommended in six months.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
E-1927-006 — 1927-09-20 — ROOF — SEASONAL OBSERVATION
Location: Main Building, Roof
Observed by: J. P. Marsh, Building Superintendent

Inspected roof after heavy rain. Found two small leaks at the parapet wall on
the west side. Water staining visible on ceiling below in Gallery A. Temporary
patch applied. Recommend full re-pointing of parapet coping before winter.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
E-1927-007 — 1927-10-14 — EXHIBIT CASE LIGHTING — REPAIR
Location: Gallery C, South Wing
Reported by: Curator of Natural History

Two exhibit case lamps would not light. Found broken sockets in both cases.
Replaced sockets and wired in new cord. Cases re-lamped and tested. Lighting
now operates correctly. No further work required.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
E-1927-008 — 1927-11-02 — BOILER NO. 1 — SEASONAL START-UP
Location: Power House, Boiler Room
Performed by: B. Kowalski, Stationary Engineer

Opened steam valve to main header. Raised pressure gradually to 120 psi.
Checked all radiator traps on first floor; two traps found stuck open and
repaired. Circulated hot water to basement radiators. Building heat now on for
the season. Coal bin refilled; 40 tons on hand.
Semi-annual inspection completed. Lubricated hoist cables and guide
shoes. Adjusted car gate contacts. Checked travel limits; both limits
functioning. Tested emergency stop switch; operates correctly. No
abnormal wear noted in machine room. Next inspection recommended in
six months.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
E-1928-002 — 1928-02-21 — EXHIBIT CASE LIGHTING — REPAIR
Location: Gallery B, East Wing
Reported by: Curator of Art

Two exhibit case lamps flickering. Found loose connections at the
socket terminals in both cases. Tightened connections and replaced one
worn cord. Cases re-lamped and tested. Lighting now operates correctly.
No further work required.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
E-1928-003 — 1928-03-12 — BOILER NO. 1 — ROUTINE MAINTENANCE
Location: Power House, Boiler Room
Performed by: B. Kowalski, Stationary Engineer

Cleaned fire tubes and removed soot buildup. Checked safety valve;
opened and reseated properly. Tested low-water cutoff; functioning.
Inspect draft fan bearings; added grease. Boiler returned to service.
Steam pressure steady at 120 psi.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
E-1928-004 — 1928-04-03 — ROOF — SEASONAL OBSERVATION
Location: Main Building, Roof
Observed by: J. P. Marsh, Building Superintendent

Spring inspection. No new leaks found. Parapet coping re-pointed in
March as recommended; patch at west parapet holding. Cleared debris from
two roof drains. Checked flashing around skylight; appears sound.
Gutters cleaned and downspouts flushed.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
E-1928-005 — 1928-05-22 — NORTH ENTRANCE DOORS — REPAIR
Location: Main Building, North Entrance
Reported by: Security Staff

The Historic Mechanical Systems Log earliest_entry_date is 1998-01-12. Record status: historical.

One door would not latch properly. Found strike plate misaligned;
adjusted and re-secured. Oiled latch mechanism. Door now closes and
latches correctly. Second door checked; no issues found.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
E-1928-006 — 1928-06-18 — EXHIBIT CASE LIGHTING — ROUTINE MAINTENANCE
Location: Gallery C, South Wing
Performed by: J. P. Marsh, Building Superintendent

Replaced all exhibit case lamps in Gallery C as part of semi-annual
schedule. Cleaned reflectors and contacts. Tested each case; all lamps
operating. Stored old lamps for potential reuse.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
E-1928-007 — 1928-07-09 — OLD MAIN ELEVATOR — ROUTINE MAINTENANCE
Location: Main Building, Central Shaft
Maintenance performed by: Meridian Elevator & Hoist Co. (call-out)

Inspected elevator after fifteen months of service. Adjusted door
interlocks. Lubricated guide shoes and hoist cables. Checked travel
limits; both limits functioning. Replaced worn contact in car call
button. Car floor and cab interior cleaned. No abnormal wear noted.
Next inspection recommended in six months.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
E-1928-008 — 1928-08-14 — ROOF — REPAIR
Location: Main Building, Roof
Performed by: J. P. Marsh, Building Superintendent

Found small leak at east parapet wall during inspection. Water staining
visible on ceiling below in Gallery D. Applied temporary patch. Will
monitor after next heavy rain. Recommend full re-pointing of east
parapet coping before winter.
------------------------------------------------------------------------
E-1928-009 — 1928-09-05 — BOILER ROOM — ROUTINE MAINTENANCE
Location: Main Building, Basement
Performed by: J. P. Marsh, Building Superintendent

Opened boiler room for fall inspection. Cleaned boiler tubes and
firebox. Checked safety valve; operates freely. Inspected steam
lines for leaks; none found. Replaced packing on feed pump
gland. Recorded water level; noting slight drop over past month,
likely due to evaporation. Will monitor.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
E-1928-010 — 1928-10-02 — OLD MAIN ELEVATOR — INSPECTION
Location: Main Building, Central Shaft
Inspected by: Meridian Elevator & Hoist Co. (scheduled)

Six-month inspection per E-1928-007 recommendation. Checked all
functions: door interlocks, travel limits, car call buttons, and
emergency stop. Lubricated guide shoes. No abnormal wear or
noise reported. All systems in satisfactory condition. Next
inspection recommended in six months.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
E-1928-011 — 1928-11-15 — NORTH WING RADIATORS — REPAIR
Location: North Wing, Galleries A and B
Performed by: J. P. Marsh, Building Superintendent

Several radiators in North Wing reported cold. Found air locks in
two units; bled and refilled. Third radiator had stuck valve;
disassembled, cleaned, and reassembled. All radiators now heating
evenly. Note: Gallery B radiator valve stem is worn; recommend
replacement before next season.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
E-1928-012 — 1928-12-20 — EXTERIOR LIGHTING — ROUTINE MAINTENANCE
Location: Main Building, Exterior
Performed by: J. P. Marsh, Building Superintendent

Replaced two burned-out lamps at east entrance. Cleaned all
exterior fixtures and replaced cracked lens on west side lamp.
Checked photocell controls; all functioning. Timers adjusted for
winter schedule.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
E-1929-001 — 1929-01-10 — ROOF — INSPECTION
Location: Main Building, Roof
Performed by: J. P. Marsh, Building Superintendent

Inspected roof after heavy snow. No leaks reported. Checked east
parapet patch from E-1928-008; holding well. Cleared snow from
roof drains. No ice dams observed. Will re-inspect after thaw.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
E-1929-002 — 1929-02-14 — OLD MAIN ELEVATOR — ROUTINE MAINTENANCE
Location: Main Building, Central Shaft
Maintenance performed by: Meridian Elevator & Hoist Co. (call-out)

Called out for intermittent stopping between floors. Found worn
brush on main motor; replaced. Adjusted brake clearance. Tested
all floors; operation smooth. No further issues reported.

E-1929-003 — 1929-03-08 — PLUMBING — REPAIR
Location: Main Building, Men's Restroom, First Floor
Performed by: J. P. Marsh, Building Superintendent

Leaking supply line under sink. Shut off water, replaced section
of pipe, and re-soldered joints. Restored water service. Checked
other restrooms for similar issues; none found.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
E-1929-004 — 1929-04-19 — EXHIBIT CASE LIGHTING — ROUTINE MAINTENANCE
Location: Gallery C, South Wing
Performed by: J. P. Marsh, Building Superintendent

Semi-annual lamp replacement in Gallery C. Replaced all lamps,
cleaned reflectors and contacts. Tested each case; all operating.
Stored old lamps for potential reuse.

Performed by: J. P. Marsh, Building Superintendent

North entrance door closer failing; door would not latch fully.

E-1929-008 — 1929-07-17 — EXHIBIT CASE LIGHTING — ROUTINE MAINTENANCE

humming; noted for replacement if worsens. All other cases in
Gallery A operating at normal brightness.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
E-1929-009 — 1929-08-09 — PLUMBING — REPAIR
Location: Main Building, Women's Restroom, Second Floor
Performed by: J. P. Marsh, Building Superintendent

Toilet running continuously. Replaced flapper valve and seat.
Adjusted float arm to correct water level. No further leakage.
Tested flush several times; operates quietly and stops properly.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
E-1929-010 — 1929-09-03 — ROOF — INSPECTION
Location: Main Building, Roof
Performed by: J. P. Marsh, Building Superintendent

Routine fall inspection. Checked all flashing and skylight seals.
Found small crack in skylight seal at north end. Applied
roofing cement as temporary measure. Will monitor. All drains
clear. No other issues observed.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
E-1929-011 — 1929-10-21 — HEATING SYSTEM — SEASONAL START-UP
Location: Main Building, Basement Boiler Room
Performed by: J. P. Marsh, Building Superintendent

Opened steam valves and started Boiler No. 1 for heating season.
Bled air from all radiators on first, second, and third floors.
Checked steam traps; two replaced (radiators in offices 12 and 27).
System brought up to pressure gradually over four hours. No leaks

E-1929-012 — 1929-11-15 — OLD MAIN ELEVATOR — INSPECTION
Location: Main Building, Central Shaft
Performed by: J. P. Marsh, Building Superintendent and Meridian

Location: Main Building, Central Shaft
Performed by: J. P. Marsh, Building Superintendent and Meridian

and tested operation through several cycles. Stoker runs quiet
and feeds evenly. Cleaned coal dust from motor housing.

Location: Gallery B, Second Floor
Performed by: J. P. Marsh, Building Superintendent

Replaced four lamps in ceiling fixtures. Two fixtures had loose
sockets; tightened. Dusted all globes and reflectors. Checked
thermostat in gallery; reads 68 degrees, acceptable for winter
display conditions.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
E-1930-001 — 1930-01-08 — PLUMBING — REPAIR
Location: Main Building, Men's Restroom, First Floor
Performed by: J. P. Marsh, Building Superintendent

Sink drain clogged. Removed trap and cleared blockage consisting
of hair and soap residue. Reassembled and tested; drains freely.
Caulked around sink rim where water had seeped into cabinet.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
E-1930-002 — 1930-02-14 — OLD MAIN ELEVATOR — ROUTINE MAINTENANCE
Location: Main Building, Central Shaft
Performed by: J. P. Marsh, Building Superintendent

Monthly lubrication of car guides and door tracks. Checked oil
level in hydraulic reservoir; topped up with one quart of
specified oil. Wiped down car interior and polished brass handrail.
No unusual noises during operation.

Location: Main Building, Roof
Performed by: J. P. Marsh, Building Superintendent

Skylight seal at north end (noted E-1929-010) continued to leak
during recent rains. Removed old cement and applied fresh roofing
compound over a wider area. Will monitor closely. Also checked
all other skylight seals; no further deterioration found.

documents.content:
------------------------------------------------------------------------
E-1927-002 — 1927-06-03 — BOILER NO. 1 — ROUTINE MAINTENANCE
Location: Power House, Boiler Room
Maintenance performed by: B. Kowalski, Stationary Engineer

Cleaned fire tubes and removed scale from the water side. Checked safety valve
setting: 125 psi. Replaced one gauge glass. Fired up and tested; appears to hold
pressure satisfactorily. Boiler room floor swept and tools returned to rack.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
E-1927-003 — 1927-06-28 — LIGHTING CIRCUIT — REPAIR
Location: Gallery B, East Wing
Reported by: Night Watchman R. O’Brien

Two ceiling fixtures in Gallery B flickering during evening hours. Found loose
connection at the junction box above the ceiling. Tightened and taped. Replaced
one lamp. Circuit tested with a lamp load; all outlets now steady. No further
trouble reported.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
E-1927-004 — 1927-07-12 — PUMP NO. 2 — ROUTINE MAINTENANCE
Location: Power House, Pump Room
Maintenance performed by: B. Kowalski, Stationary Engineer

Packed the stuffing box on Pump No. 2. Adjusted belt tension. Oiled all grease
cups. Pump ran for one hour under load; discharge pressure steady at 60 psi.
Noted that the suction strainer is corroding; recommend replacement within the
year.

Marginal note (pencil, E. Vance, 1999): “Strainer replaced 1928-01-15, see
E-1928-002.”

------------------------------------------------------------------------
E-1927-005 — 1927-08-05 — OLD MAIN ELEVATOR — ROUTINE MAINTENANCE
Location: Main Building, Central Shaft
Maintenance performed by: Meridian Elevator & Hoist Co. (call-out)

The Historic Mechanical Systems Log entry E-1927-001 records that Old Main Elevator installation_date was 1927-05-15. Record status: current.

Inspected elevator after three months of service. Adjusted door interlocks.
Lubricated guide shoes and hoist cables. Checked travel limits; both limits
functioning. Car floor and cab interior cleaned. No abnormal wear noted.
Next inspection recommended in six months.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
E-1927-006 — 1927-09-20 — ROOF — SEASONAL OBSERVATION
Location: Main Building, Roof
Observed by: J. P. Marsh, Building Superintendent

Inspected roof after heavy rain. Found two small leaks at the parapet wall on
the west side. Water staining visible on ceiling below in Gallery A. Temporary
patch applied. Recommend full re-pointing of parapet coping before winter.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
E-1927-007 — 1927-10-14 — EXHIBIT CASE LIGHTING — REPAIR
Location: Gallery C, South Wing
Reported by: Curator of Natural History

Two exhibit case lamps would not light. Found broken sockets in both cases.
Replaced sockets and wired in new cord. Cases re-lamped and tested. Lighting
now operates correctly. No further work required.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
E-1927-008 — 1927-11-02 — BOILER NO. 1 — SEASONAL START-UP
Location: Power House, Boiler Room
Performed by: B. Kowalski, Stationary Engineer

Opened steam valve to main header. Raised pressure gradually to 120 psi.
Checked all radiator traps on first floor; two traps found stuck open and
repaired. Circulated hot water to basement radiators. Building heat now on for
the season. Coal bin refilled; 40 tons on hand.
